language_instruction: Pick up the batteries from the yellow foam blocks and insert them into the holes in the red foam fixture.
action_semantics: Absolute joint position targets in radians, 7 arm + 6 independent Revo2 motors per side; URDF mimic couplings drive distal joints.
camera_calibration_status: Head user-supplied K with provisional KB4 interpretation; wrist roll and pitch follow the user-authoritative 20260824 request_000001 images. Circular fisheye K and real hand-eye remain image-based estimates.

head.calibration_status: User-supplied rgb.right K and resolution; KB4 distortion interpretation and robot-to-E6 mount remain provisional.

calibration.distortion_interpretation: OpenCV fisheye / Kannala-Brandt k1,k2,k3,k4; final four source entries are zero padding. Vendor model still unconfirmed.

head.mount_estimate: Provisional external E6 right-eye location above/in front of the CAD head, inferred from stored real E6 imagery. Relative to the previous built-in optical frame: world displacement [+0.08,-0.033,+0.18] m at the fixed workcell pose. Not a measured hand-eye transform.

parameter_status.geometry: User measurements for table, foam, battery and hole diameter/depth; hole pitch and object placement estimated from photos.
parameter_status.masses_friction_gains: Battery mass and friction are provisional; existing robot gains retained.
parameter_status.foam_compliance: Rigid approximation only; equal nominal diameters require a separate compliance/contact validation before insertion-force claims.

locked_joint_reason: Fixed workcell task: chassis, torso and head pose remain constant; actions control only the two arms and Revo2 hands.
servo: Torque-limited PD plus model gravity feedforward at 960 Hz; VLA actions and cameras at 30 Hz.

real_camera_contract.raw_umi_sample_warning: Three audited task_v2_x2 streams decode to 3840x1200 stereo, while session metadata declares 3200x1200; do not reuse a fixed 1600-pixel split without checking the bitstream.

reset_pose.status: Image-guided estimate, used by actual environment reset and saved scene; not a measured full-arm real-robot pose.
reset_pose.wrist_view_expectation: At reset, palms face inward, left palm is on the left of its image, right palm on the right; both thumbs above fingers and table edges approximately horizontal.

scripted_grasp_parameters.offset_convention: World cube center minus right-hand base position at grasp, with the palm-down test orientation.
scripted_grasp_parameters.offset_basis: Matched to the cube center in the actual hand frame during the previously successful stable pinch: approximately [0.050,0.036,0.087] m in hand coordinates.

relocation.user_correction: Robot and white table moved beside the computer; computer workstation remained fixed.
relocation.placement_basis: White table to photo-right of stationary optical/computer desk, rear edges aligned; approximately 14mm lateral gap from modeled desk. Absolute placement remains estimated.
relocation.loose_accessories: Old headset intersecting new tabletop hidden; powerstrip moved from new robot footprint to under desk. These accessory positions are photo-based estimates.

insertion_geometry.diameter_source: user confirms same diameter as battery
